posts.summary_en: How Stellar Link works: up to 12 points per constellation, the stat bonus follows the area of the polygon drawn in point order; up to 6 points can be locked, and a roll costs 10 Stellar Points unlocked and 220 with 6 locks. Later constellations give more per % of area: constellation 2 at 100% gives 30% amplification, constellation 3 at 88% with only 7 points gives 35%, constellation 4 at 96% gives 48%. So: take 60–70% early without locking and save points for the next constellation; shape-by-shape maxima for 3–6 points (3 points: 1.82% per unlocked roll, about 550 SP); after 6 points the gain per point spent is small, and 86% is enough to clear every stage. New points open as total cookie stars reach the unlock conditions.

datapoints.cost: 10 SP per roll unlocked; 220 with 6 locked
datapoints.note: the stat the % applies to is the screenshot's amplification line

advice.text: Early: roll unlocked to ~70% and move on; later constellations give more per % of area.

posts.title_en: Gear basics and running two presets
posts.summary_en: Gear slots and their main stats; run a stage preset (accuracy/focus) and a combat preset. Power weights differ by option, but 'power can be made up with Resolve, cookie stars, the collection', so pick useful options over displayed power, except when padding to the 55% line. Replies: before stage 100 the highest-power gear is best; by 168 aim for accuracy mid-800s and focus 800–900; about 50,000 cutters come from quests by 168-30 alone, so average stars rise naturally.

advice.text: Before stage 100 wear the highest-power gear; later pick accuracy/focus for the stage preset unless padding for the 55% line.

quotes.en: Power can be made up with Resolve, cookie stars and the collection, so pick the key options even if power drops

posts.summary_en: Stage preset: about 80% of the stage's accuracy/focus requirement, finally 1,000 each, then highest power toward the 55% line. Max gear level = oven level × 3, so opening the oven never ends. In a reply the author states that displayed power only matters in stages ('전투력 수치가 관여하는 건 스테이지 뿐'), Arena and conquest go by options.

advice.text: Stage preset: accuracy/focus to ~80% of requirement (1,000/1,000 at the end), then raw power.

posts.summary_en: Image table of the stages where offline reward boxes increase, with power lines (images local only).

The cafe's largest guide. Cookie level 1–100, free level reset (:428-439); stars to 10, big jumps at 5★ and 8★ (:442-457); Resolve to 1,500, easy early and about a level a day late (:475-480); when stuck: retry, fix accuracy/focus, cookie levels, Resolve, pet and cookie stars, then Stellar and runes (:543-560); lab special research priorities (:568-581); coin auto-hunt rewards into Resolve when stuck (:731-734); purchase tiers: Ad Removal, Unique gear, Crumble Pass; then 5.5 permanent, 1.5 monthly gacha, weekly keys; then the stage pass after 168, the 300 Chocosteel + 60 Syrup deal, TSSR to 5★, Stellar packs; beyond that plate packages (:832-856); Stellar shapes and costs, 8-point 91% for about 1,900 SP, 10-point 95% expected ~7,900, compromise at 88–93% (:1168-1257); plating in steps of 5, weapons first, no Syrup to 15 (:1278-1292); shop orders: mileage keys then Stellar; victory medals Chocosteel > Syrup > Stellar > cutters; Rumble shop keys > Syrup > Chocosteel > Stellar (:1297-1340).

advice.text: Ad Removal, Unique gear, Crumble Pass → 5.5, monthly gacha, weekly keys → stage pass, Chocosteel/Syrup deal, TSSR 5★, Stellar → plate packages.

posts.summary_en: Growth elements: Resolve (coins; each tier needs ATK, DEF and HP maxed) (:48-51); Fame (victory medals; each level raises boss, element and crit damage) (:53-59); Gnome Lab (basic and special research stones; special 5, 7, 8, 10, 14 first) (:61-66); Stellar Link (Stellar Points; constellations open by cookie stars, later ones amplify more; roll unlocked to mid-80% and improve later) (:68-74); plating (drops from 10, shatters from 15 — before 1.4.002 —, sub-stats amplify every 5) (:131-134); sugar runes (:136-149). Arena applies level, promotion, pets, collection, gear, plates, runes but not the Gnome or guild labs (:95-96). The guild is 'mandatory' for lab speed-ups and the guild lab (:111-116).

advice.text: Join a guild: lab help and guild lab stats.

quotes.en: Getting it right is whale territory, so aim for the mid-80s with unlocked 10-point rolls
